__comment__: EconomyX — phone hold poses. ONE file drives all 26 phones, because every
phone geometry uses a single bone named 'phone'.
Each geometry is already raised so its origin sits at the LOWER THIRD of the
body — that is where a hand actually grips a phone. So position [0,0,0] puts
the grip point in the palm, with roughly a third of the phone below the hand
and two thirds standing above it.
TUNING — grip poses always want a nudge or two once you see them in game.
Edit ONLY this file; nothing else references these numbers.
phone clips into the arm ............ raise position[1], or lower scale
screen faces away in first person ... make rotation[0] more negative (toward -90)
phone lies flat instead of upright .. move rotation[0] toward 0
sits too far left/right of the hand . adjust position[0]
